unit: Universal section upper bound, big and projective singular metrics, and scoped line-bundle volume

Complete active graph preserved. Q07 smooth Bergman rescaling, fixed-data section bound and positive bundle embedding/divisor proofs; Q05 birational weighted transformation; Q06 gentle type and analytic integrability; Q09 bounded Stokes, mass bounds and boundary class-volume definition; Q10 all-mass perturbed-model limit and big-class strict minorant; Q12 convex distance convergence; Q13 pure/mixed multiplier continuity checked in their exact scope.

proof_scope: Arbitrary smooth-metric limiting local Morse upper bound; fixed-divisor section loss with fixed-data constants. Universal multiplier-volume upper bound with curvature allowance and the zero-volume case on every compact Kahler manifold. Exact singular-section formula in big classes; positive multiplier volume implies integral-class bigness on manifolds carrying a positive bundle, giving all-metric formula there. Minimal current attains boundary class volume. Unweighted fixed-twist volume formula in big or zero-volume classes and exact minimal-weight section identity for all pseudo-effective line bundles. General compact Kahler positive-volume bigness remains unproved.
review_method: Scoped authoring-agent mathematical/editorial review, not independent certification. All 24 first selected affected images and three second changed images inspected. Wide local-Morse display split; nef proof shortened with fixed-data constants retained. Matching page-body text excludes running heads and does not assert byte-identical images.
